---
title: "load_data"
output: html_document
---

```{r load packages}
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
```

Import beedata and mapp_data, create metadata frame
```{r import data, include = FALSE}
# nolint start: nonportable_path_linter.
beedata <- read_excel("../beedata_RRproject_2025.xlsx", skip = 1)

mappingdata <- read_excel("../mappingdata_RRproject_2025.xlsx", skip = 1)

canopyhp <- read_excel("../canopydata_RRproject_2025.xlsx", skip = 1)
# nolint end
```

```{r save raw data}
write.csv(beedata,
          file.path("..", "data", "raw", "beedata.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(mappingdata,
          file.path("..", "data", "raw", "mappingdata.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(canopyhp,
          file.path("..", "data", "raw", "canopyhp.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```
